target_pattern: Use gerundio forms only for verbal action patterns (not noun uses), including estar, seguir, llevar, terminar/acabar, andar, method expressions, perception verbs, and simultaneous action frames.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using Spanish gerundio where English uses ing as a noun.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish infinitives express noun-like actions, while gerundio forms mark actions in progress or linked action framing.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the target gerundio pattern.
prompts_en: I was sleeping when you arrived.
They were talking when I arrived.
He was cooking when it started to rain.
Maria has been living in Spain for two years.
I have been working here for five months.
We have been studying Spanish for a long time.
He has been waiting for the bus for thirty minutes.
We keep asking the same thing.
They keep working even when it is late.
I saw my boss buying something.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Estoy hablando con mi amigo. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Estamos comiendo tacos. -> change object to ensalada.
Base: Ella esta viendo la pelicula. -> change to ellos.
Base: Ellos estan leyendo un libro. -> change noun to plural libros.
Base: El esta oyendo un ruido. -> change verb to escuchar keeping progressive.
Base: Estoy estudiando espanol ahora mismo. -> make it negative.
Base: Estas escribiendo una carta. -> make it question form with usted.
Base: El esta bebiendo cafe. -> change object to te.
Base: Estamos limpiando la casa. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Ellos estan durmiendo en la sala. -> change location to el dormitorio.
Base: Estoy diciendo algo importante. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: El esta pidiendo ayuda. -> change to plural subject ellos.
Base: Ella esta explicando el problema. -> change object to la solucion.
Base: Ellos estan construyendo una casa. -> change to singular subject el.
Base: Ellos estan siguiendo las instrucciones. -> change to singular yo.

prompts: Running is good for you. (Correr es bueno para ti. vs Corriendo es bueno para ti.)
I am hearing a noise. (Estoy oyendo un ruido. vs Estoy oiendo un ruido.)
She is asking for help. (Ella esta pidiendo ayuda. vs Ella esta pediendo ayuda.)
They are saying the truth. (Ellos estan diciendo la verdad. vs Ellos estan deciendo la verdad.)
We keep working. (Seguimos trabajando. vs Seguimos trabajar.)
I have been living here for three years. (Llevo tres anos viviendo aqui. vs Llevo tres anos vivir aqui.)
We ended up eating at home. (Terminamos comiendo en casa. vs Terminamos comer en casa.)
I cut the bread using a knife. (Corte el pan usando un cuchillo. vs Corte el pan por usar un cuchillo.)
I saw Maria dancing. (Vi a Maria bailando. vs Vi Maria bailando.)
He left crying. (Se fue llorando. vs Se fue llorar.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that you are reading a report right now.
Write that your team is preparing lunch.
Write that you have been working from home for six months.
Write that you keep practicing Spanish every day.
Write that your friend keeps complaining about traffic.
Write that you ended up staying home tonight.
Write that your coworkers ended up finishing late.
Write that you spent the morning answering emails.
Write that your manager goes around asking questions.
Write that you learned by watching experts.
Write that you saw your colleague writing notes.
Write that you woke up thinking about work.
Write that your partner left laughing.
Write that your neighbors are building a house.
Write that you are trying to improve your Spanish.

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish, not literal English.
prompts_en: She has been waiting for an hour.
He ended up buying the expensive one.
I go around looking for my keys.
They improved by practicing every day.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing spelling change in oir gerund.
Infinitive instead of gerund after llevar + time.
Missing gerund after terminar/acabar in this pattern.

common_errors.mistake: Using por + infinitive in method expressions

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing personal a with person object.
